senses.en: During the time from midnight until just before midday.

ex_en: My alarm rings at seven a.m. every weekday.
ex_zh: 每个工作日，我的闹钟都在早上七点响。

senses.en: concerning a particular subject
approximately, rather than exactly
in various places within or around somewhere

ex_en: We talked about our holiday plans over dinner.
ex_zh: 我们吃晚饭时聊了假期计划。

senses.en: In a higher position than something else.
Greater than a particular amount, level, or standard.
In a higher place or earlier in a piece of writing.

ex_en: A small wooden shelf hangs above the kitchen sink.
ex_zh: 厨房水槽上方挂着一个小木架。

senses.en: Something done to achieve a result or address a problem.
A particular thing that someone does.
Exciting events in a story, film, or real situation.

ex_en: We need to take action before the leak worsens.
ex_zh: 我们得在漏水加重之前采取行动。

senses.en: Something people do for enjoyment, learning, or a particular purpose.
The state of being busy or doing things.

ex_en: Painting is my favourite activity on rainy afternoons.
ex_zh: 下雨的午后，我最喜欢的活动是画画。

senses.en: Someone who performs characters in plays, films, or television
A person or organisation involved in a particular situation
senses.ja_yomi: かんけいしゃ、こういしゃ

ex_en: The actor wore a silver crown on stage.
ex_zh: 那位演员在舞台上戴着一顶银色王冠。

senses.en: to put something with something else or increase an amount
to combine numbers to find their total
to say something more after an earlier statement

ex_en: Add a little milk if the soup is too thick.
ex_zh: 如果汤太稠，就加一点牛奶。

senses.en: Details identifying where someone lives or something can be found.
To give attention to a problem and try to solve it.
senses.ja_yomi: とりくむ、たいしょする

senses.en: To speak directly to a person or group.
senses.ja_yomi: はなしかける、えんぜつする

ex_en: Please send me your address before I post the parcel.
ex_zh: 请在我寄包裹之前把你的地址发给我。

senses.en: A powered flying vehicle with fixed wings.

ex_en: The aeroplane flew low over the sandy beach.
ex_zh: 飞机低空飞过沙滩上方。

senses.en: feeling fear or worry about something
senses.ja_yomi: こわがって、しんぱいして

senses.en: used to introduce unwelcome information politely
senses.ja_yomi: ざんねんながら〜とおもう

ex_en: The puppy was afraid of the noisy vacuum cleaner.
ex_zh: 那只小狗害怕吵闹的吸尘器。

senses.en: later than an event or time
following the time when something happens
behind or following someone or something

ex_en: We usually take a short walk after dinner.
ex_zh: 我们通常在晚饭后散一小会儿步。

senses.en: The time between midday and evening.

ex_en: We spent the afternoon baking bread in the kitchen.
ex_zh: 我们整个下午都在厨房里烤面包。

senses.en: One more time, or on another occasion.

ex_en: Could you say that again a little more slowly?
ex_zh: 你能再说一遍，稍微慢一点吗？

senses.en: The length of time someone or something has existed.
A period of history with particular features.
To become older or make someone or something seem older.

ex_en: My grandmother learned to swim at the age of seventy.
ex_zh: 我奶奶七十岁时学会了游泳。

senses.en: Before the present time, following an expression of time

ex_en: I left my umbrella on the bus an hour ago.
ex_zh: 一小时前，我把雨伞落在了公交车上。

senses.en: Have the same opinion or accept someone else's view
senses.ja_yomi: さんせいする、どういする

senses.en: Decide something together or promise to do something
senses.ja: 取り決める、引き受ける
senses.ja_yomi: とりきめる、ひきうける

ex_en: I agree with you that this soup needs salt.
ex_zh: 我同意你的看法，这汤需要加盐。

senses.en: A powered flying vehicle with fixed wings.

ex_en: We watched the airplane disappear behind a white cloud.
ex_zh: 我们看着飞机消失在一朵白云后面。

senses.en: A place where planes take off, land, and collect passengers

ex_en: We arrived at the airport before the sun rose.
ex_zh: 太阳还没升起，我们就到了机场。

senses.en: A collection of recorded music released as one product.
A book for keeping photographs, stamps or similar collections.
senses.ja_yomi: アルバム、しゃしんちょう

ex_en: Her new album kept us singing all afternoon.
ex_zh: 她的新专辑让我们跟着唱了整整一个下午。

senses.en: the whole amount of something or every member of a group
everything or everyone in a particular group
completely or entirely

ex_en: All the children brought fruit for the picnic.
ex_zh: 所有孩子都带了水果来野餐。

senses.en: Nearly, but not completely or not quite.
senses.ja_yomi: ほとんど、もうすこしで

ex_en: I almost missed the bus while tying my shoes.
ex_zh: 我系鞋带时差点错过了公交车。

senses.en: without anyone else present
without other people or their help
senses.ja_yomi: ひとりで、どくりょくで

senses.en: only, excluding everything or everyone else

ex_en: I was alone in the kitchen when the kettle boiled.
ex_zh: 水壶里的水烧开时，厨房里只有我一个人。

senses.en: following the length or direction of something
forward from one place towards another
with someone when they go somewhere

ex_en: We walked along the river and watched the ducks.
ex_zh: 我们沿着河边散步，看着水里的鸭子。

senses.en: before now or earlier than expected

ex_en: I have already packed my bag for tomorrow.
ex_zh: 我已经收拾好明天要用的包了。

senses.en: in addition to something already mentioned

ex_en: My sister plays tennis and also enjoys swimming.
ex_zh: 我姐姐打网球，也喜欢游泳。

senses.en: every time or on every occasion
throughout all time or for ever

ex_en: My neighbour always waves when she sees me.
ex_zh: 我的邻居每次看见我都会挥手。

senses.en: Connects words or statements that belong together.
Connects an action with what follows or results from it.

ex_en: I bought fresh bread and cheese for our picnic.
ex_zh: 我为我们的野餐买了新鲜面包和奶酪。

senses.en: feeling strong displeasure about something unfair, wrong, or unpleasant

ex_en: He felt angry when someone damaged his bicycle.
ex_zh: 有人弄坏了他的自行车，他感到很生气。

senses.en: a living creature that feeds on plants or other creatures
relating to animals rather than plants

ex_en: My sister loves watching animals at the local farm.
ex_zh: 我妹妹喜欢在当地农场看动物。

senses.en: one more, or a different one
one more person or thing, or a different one
senses.ja_yomi: もうひとつ、べつのもの

ex_en: This cup is cracked, so please bring me another.
ex_zh: 这个杯子裂了，请再给我拿一个。

senses.en: a reply, correct result, or solution to a problem
to reply to someone or respond to a call
senses.ja_yomi: こたえる、（でんわに）でる

ex_en: I asked the price, but nobody gave an answer.
ex_zh: 我问了价格，却没有人回答。

senses.en: Some in questions or negatives; whichever one, without restriction.
senses.ja: いくらかの、どんな〜でも

senses.en: Some or whichever ones, without naming the people or things.
At all, used mainly with comparisons in questions or negatives.

ex_en: You can borrow any book from this shelf.
ex_zh: 这个书架上的书，你想借哪本都可以。

senses.en: Any person, or someone whose identity is not specified.

ex_en: Does anybody know where I left my blue umbrella?
ex_zh: 有人知道我把蓝色雨伞放在哪里了吗？

senses.en: any person, without restriction
a person, used in questions and negative statements

ex_en: Anyone can join our weekend walk by the river.
ex_zh: 任何人都可以参加我们周末的河边散步活动。

senses.en: Any thing at all, without limits on choice
Something, used especially in questions and conditional statements

ex_en: You can choose anything from this basket of toys.
ex_zh: 你可以从这篮玩具里随便挑一件。

senses.en: a round fruit with firm flesh and red or green skin

ex_en: I packed an apple and a sandwich for lunch.
ex_zh: 我装了一个苹果和一个三明治当午餐。

senses.en: The fourth month of the year.

ex_en: We are moving into our new flat in April.
ex_zh: 我们将在四月搬进新公寓。

senses.en: The body part connecting your shoulder to your hand.
A projecting part of an object, especially a chair.
To provide weapons or useful tools for a task.

ex_en: She carried the sleeping baby gently in her arms.
ex_zh: 她轻轻地把熟睡的宝宝抱在怀里。

senses.en: On different sides of something or surrounding it.
Approximately, rather than exactly.
In or to various places within an area.

ex_en: We sat around the fire and watched the stars.
ex_zh: 我们围坐在火堆旁看星星。

senses.en: To reach the place you were travelling to.
For an event or a particular time to come.

ex_en: Our guests arrived just as dinner was ready.
ex_zh: 我们的客人恰好在晚饭准备好时到了。

senses.en: creative expression through activities such as painting, sculpture, or drawing
objects or images created to express ideas or beauty
a skill developed through practice and careful understanding

ex_en: We spent the afternoon making art with coloured paper.
ex_zh: 我们花了一下午用彩纸创作艺术作品。

senses.en: A piece of writing in a newspaper, magazine, or website.
A single item, especially one belonging to a particular group.
A word such as a, an, or the before a noun.

ex_en: I read an interesting article about growing tomatoes indoors.
ex_zh: 我读了一篇关于室内种植番茄的有趣文章。

senses.en: used to indicate someone's role or something's purpose
introduces a time, reason, or way something happens
used in comparisons to show an equal degree

ex_en: She works as a guide at the local museum.
ex_zh: 她在当地博物馆担任讲解员。

senses.en: say something to get information or an answer
say that you want someone to do or give something
invite someone to come somewhere or join an activity

ex_en: I asked the driver where the bus stopped.
ex_zh: 我问司机公交车在哪里停。

senses.en: the eighth month of the year

ex_en: We usually visit our grandparents by the sea in August.
ex_zh: 我们通常八月去看望住在海边的祖父母。

senses.en: Your parent's sister, or the wife of your parent's sibling.

ex_en: My aunt taught me how to bake bread.
ex_zh: 我姨妈教会了我如何烤面包。

senses.en: The season between summer and winter

ex_en: We collect fallen leaves in the park every autumn.
ex_zh: 我们每年秋天都在公园里收集落叶。

senses.en: not sleeping
to stop sleeping or cause someone to stop sleeping

ex_en: I was still awake when the rain finally stopped.
ex_zh: 雨终于停下时，我还醒着。

senses.en: Moving or staying at a distance from someone or something.
Not at home or at the usual place.

ex_en: The little bird flew away when I opened the window.
ex_zh: 我打开窗户时，小鸟飞走了。

senses.en: a very young child or animal
senses.ja_yomi: あかちゃん、どうぶつのこ

senses.en: very young, or intended for babies
senses.ja_yomi: あかちゃんようの、ちいさな

senses.en: treat someone as helpless or needing excessive care

ex_en: The baby fell asleep while her father sang softly.
ex_zh: 爸爸轻声唱歌时，宝宝睡着了。

senses.en: The rear part of your body or of something else.
Towards the rear, or to a previous place or state.
senses.ja: うしろへ、もとの場所へ
senses.ja_yomi: うしろへ、もとのばしょへ

senses.en: To support a person, plan, or organization.

ex_en: My back feels stiff after sitting all morning.
ex_zh: 坐了一上午后，我感觉背部僵硬。

senses.en: Not good in quality or not satisfactory.
Serious, unpleasant, or likely to cause harm.
Behaving wrongly or breaking accepted rules.

ex_en: The soup tasted so bad that I stopped eating.
ex_zh: 这汤太难喝了，我便不再喝了。

senses.en: A container made from flexible material, used for carrying things.
To put something into a bag.

ex_en: She put the apples in a reusable bag.
ex_zh: 她把苹果放进了一个可重复使用的袋子里。

senses.en: A round object used in games or shaped like one.
A formal social event where people dance.

ex_en: The dog chased the ball across the grass.
ex_zh: 那只狗追着球跑过草地。

senses.en: A long curved fruit with soft flesh and usually yellow skin

ex_en: He peeled a banana and sliced it over his cereal.
ex_zh: 他剥了一根香蕉，切成片放在麦片上。

senses.en: A group of musicians who perform together.
A narrow strip or ring of material or colour.
A range of frequencies, values, or levels within a system.

ex_en: My sister plays the drums in a local band.
ex_zh: 我姐姐在当地一支乐队里打鼓。

senses.en: an organisation that holds money and provides financial services
land along the edge of a river or lake
put money into an account at a bank

ex_en: I went to the bank to open an account.
ex_zh: 我去银行开了一个账户。

senses.en: a place or counter where drinks, especially alcoholic drinks, are served
a long narrow piece of solid material
senses.ja_yomi: ぼう、いたじょうのもの

senses.en: to officially prevent someone from entering or doing something

ex_en: We ordered fresh orange juice at the hotel bar.
ex_zh: 我们在酒店的酒吧点了鲜榨橙汁。

senses.en: A team sport involving hitting a ball and running between bases
The small, hard ball used in this sport

ex_en: We played baseball in the park after lunch.
ex_zh: 午饭后，我们在公园打棒球。

senses.en: a game where teams throw a ball through raised hoops
the large round ball used in this game
senses.ja: バスケットボールのボール

ex_en: We play basketball at the park after school.
ex_zh: 放学后，我们在公园打篮球。

senses.en: A flying mammal usually active at night.
An object used to hit the ball in certain sports.
To hit or try to hit a ball with a bat.

ex_en: A bat flew above our garden at dusk.
ex_zh: 黄昏时，一只蝙蝠从我们花园上方飞过。

senses.en: Washing your body while sitting or lying in water.
A large container that you fill with water for washing yourself.

ex_en: A warm bath helped me relax after the hike.
ex_zh: 徒步之后，泡个温水澡让我放松了下来。

senses.en: A room with a bath or shower, often including a toilet.
A room containing a toilet, especially in American English.

ex_en: She hung a clean towel beside the bathroom sink.
ex_zh: 她在浴室洗手池旁挂了一条干净毛巾。

senses.en: an area of sand or small stones beside water
to bring a boat onto a shore

ex_en: We collected smooth stones on the beach after breakfast.
ex_zh: 早餐后，我们在海滩上捡了些光滑的石头。

senses.en: An edible seed, or the plant that produces it.

ex_en: I added some beans to the vegetable soup.
ex_zh: 我在蔬菜汤里加了些豆子。

senses.en: to tolerate something unpleasant or carry a heavy responsibility
a large, heavily built mammal with thick fur
to have or display a particular feature or mark

ex_en: I can't bear the noise of that old fan.
ex_zh: 我受不了那台旧风扇的噪声。

senses.en: Very pleasing to see, hear, or experience.

ex_en: The garden looks beautiful after the spring rain.
ex_zh: 春雨过后，花园看起来很美。

senses.en: Introduces the reason why something happens or is true.

ex_en: I closed the window because the room felt cold.
ex_zh: 我关上了窗户，因为房间里有点冷。

senses.en: to start to be something or develop a particular quality

ex_en: The streets become quiet after the shops close.
ex_zh: 商店关门后，街道变得安静起来。

senses.en: A piece of furniture used for sleeping
The ground at the bottom of a river, sea, or lake
An area of soil prepared for growing plants

ex_en: The cat curled up on my bed after lunch.
ex_zh: 午饭后，猫蜷缩在我的床上。

senses.en: A room used mainly for sleeping.

ex_en: My bedroom gets plenty of sunlight in the morning.
ex_zh: 我的卧室早晨阳光很充足。

senses.en: a flying insect that collects pollen; some kinds make honey

ex_en: A bee landed gently on the yellow flower.
ex_zh: 一只蜜蜂轻轻落在那朵黄花上。

senses.en: meat from cattle, eaten as food

ex_en: We cooked the beef slowly with carrots and potatoes.
ex_zh: 我们把牛肉和胡萝卜、土豆一起慢炖。

senses.en: Earlier than a particular time or event.
Earlier than the time when something happens.
At an earlier time.

ex_en: Please put your shoes by the door before dinner.
ex_zh: 请在晚饭前把鞋放到门边。

senses.en: to start happening or start doing something

ex_en: We begin dinner when everyone is sitting at the table.
ex_zh: 大家都在餐桌旁坐好后，我们开始吃晚饭。

senses.en: at or towards the back of someone or something
at the back or making less progress than expected
responsible for causing or supporting something

ex_en: Your umbrella is behind the door in the kitchen.
ex_zh: 你的伞在厨房的门后面。

senses.en: To accept that something is true or someone is truthful.
To think that something is likely or correct.
To have confidence or faith in someone or something.
senses.ja_yomi: しんらいする、しんこうする

ex_en: I believe you, but your story sounds quite unusual.
ex_zh: 我相信你，但你讲的事情听起来很不寻常。

senses.en: a hollow metal object that rings when struck
the ringing sound made by a bell

ex_en: The bicycle bell rang as a cyclist approached.
ex_zh: 一位骑车人靠近时，自行车铃响了。

senses.en: At a lower position, level, or amount than something.
In a lower place or later in a piece of writing.

ex_en: Our cat sleeps on the shelf below the window.
ex_zh: 我们的猫睡在窗户下方的架子上。

senses.en: At the side of someone or something.

ex_en: Please leave your wet boots beside the door.
ex_zh: 请把你的湿靴子放在门旁边。

senses.en: Better than all others in quality or suitability.
In the most successful way or to the greatest degree.
The finest performance, effort, or thing available.
senses.ja_yomi: さいぜん、さいこうのもの

ex_en: This bakery makes the best bread in our neighbourhood.
ex_zh: 这家面包店做的面包是我们街区最好的。

senses.en: Of higher quality or more suitable than something else.
In a more effective or satisfactory way.
Less ill than before.

ex_en: This backpack is better than my old one.
ex_zh: 这个背包比我原来的那个好。

senses.en: In the space or period separating people, things, or events.

senses.zh: 涉及双方或多方；由…共享
senses.en: Connecting distinct people or groups, or shared by them.
In the space or interval separating things.

ex_en: The cat squeezed between the sofa and the wall.
ex_zh: 猫从沙发和墙之间挤了过去。

senses.en: a two-wheeled vehicle moved by pushing pedals
to travel by bicycle

ex_en: I locked my bicycle outside the small bakery.
ex_zh: 我把自行车锁在那家小面包店外面。

senses.en: Large in size, amount, or degree.
Important or likely to have a strong effect.

ex_en: We need a big bag for all these towels.
ex_zh: 我们需要一个大袋子来装所有这些毛巾。

senses.en: a bicycle or, informally, a motorcycle
to travel somewhere by bicycle

ex_en: I locked my bike outside the corner shop.
ex_zh: 我把自行车锁在街角商店外面。

senses.en: an animal with feathers, wings, and a beak that lays eggs

ex_en: A small bird built a nest above our window.
ex_zh: 一只小鸟在我们窗户上方筑了巢。

senses.en: The event or process of a baby being born.
senses.ja_yomi: たんじょう、しゅっさん

senses.en: The beginning of something new.

ex_en: The whole family celebrated the birth of our daughter.
ex_zh: 全家人都庆祝了我们女儿的出生。

senses.en: The yearly anniversary of the day someone was born.

ex_en: My sister baked a lemon cake for my birthday.
ex_zh: 姐姐为我的生日烤了一个柠檬蛋糕。

senses.en: a small, flat, crisp baked food, often sweet
a small, soft bread roll raised without yeast
senses.ja: やわらかい丸パン（アメリカ）
senses.ja_yomi: やわらかいまるパン（アメリカ）

ex_en: She dipped a biscuit into her warm tea.
ex_zh: 她把一块饼干浸进温热的茶里。

senses.en: having the darkest colour, like coal
the darkest colour
relating to people with ancestry from sub-Saharan Africa

ex_en: She wore a black coat and bright yellow boots.
ex_zh: 她穿着黑色外套和亮黄色靴子。

senses.en: having no writing, pictures, or other content
showing no understanding, feeling, or recognition
senses.ja: ぼんやりした、無表情な
senses.ja_yomi: ぼんやりした、むひょうじょうな

senses.en: an empty space where information should be added

ex_en: She handed me a blank sheet and some pencils.
ex_zh: 她递给我一张白纸和几支铅笔。

senses.en: A solid piece of material with fairly flat sides.
To stop movement or prevent something from happening.
An area between streets, or a large building.

ex_en: The sculptor carved a bird from a block of wood.
ex_zh: 雕刻家用一块木头雕出了一只鸟。

senses.en: to move air, or move because of moving air
an event that causes disappointment, difficulty, or loss
a hard hit with a hand or object

ex_en: A cold wind blew leaves across the empty playground.
ex_zh: 一阵冷风把树叶吹过空荡荡的操场。

senses.en: having the colour of a clear daytime sky
the colour of a clear daytime sky
feeling sad or unhappy

ex_en: He wore a blue jacket to the picnic.
ex_zh: 他穿了一件蓝色夹克去野餐。

senses.en: A flat piece of wood or other firm material.
A group responsible for managing an organisation or making decisions.
senses.ja_yomi: いいんかい、とりしまりやくかい

senses.en: Get onto a ship, aircraft, train, or bus.

ex_en: She placed a wooden board across the muddy path.
ex_zh: 她在泥泞的小路上横放了一块木板。

senses.en: a vessel for travelling on water, usually smaller than a ship

ex_en: We hired a small boat and explored the lake.
ex_zh: 我们租了一条小船，游览了湖面。

senses.en: The whole physical structure of a person or animal.
An organized group with a particular purpose.
The main or central part of something.

ex_en: My whole body aches after yesterday's long walk.
ex_zh: 昨天走了很长一段路，现在我全身酸痛。

senses.en: One of the hard parts forming a body's supporting frame.
To remove the bones from meat or fish.

ex_en: He broke a bone in his wrist while skating.
ex_zh: 他滑冰时摔断了手腕的一块骨头。

senses.en: A set of pages joined together for reading
To arrange in advance to use a service or attend something

ex_en: I left my book on the kitchen table.
ex_zh: 我把书落在厨房的桌子上了。

senses.en: a store that sells books

ex_en: The bookstore near my flat stays open until nine.
ex_zh: 我公寓附近的书店一直营业到九点。

senses.en: Not interesting or exciting.
senses.ja_yomi: たいくつな、つまらない

ex_en: The film was so boring that I fell asleep.
ex_zh: 这部电影太无聊了，我都睡着了。

senses.en: To take and use something with permission, then return it.
To use an idea or word from another source.

ex_en: Could I borrow your umbrella until tomorrow morning?

senses.en: An activity you regularly do for pleasure in your free time

ex_en: Growing herbs on my balcony has become my favourite hobby.
ex_zh: 在阳台种香草已成了我最喜欢的业余爱好。

senses.en: to keep something in your hands or arms
to organise an event or meeting
to have enough space for something or someone

ex_en: Could you hold my bag while I tie my shoes?
ex_zh: 我系鞋带时，你能帮我拿一下包吗？

senses.en: An opening through something or a hollow space in the ground.
A weakness or missing part in a plan or argument.

ex_en: There's a small hole in my favourite sock.
ex_zh: 我最喜欢的袜子上有一个小洞。

senses.en: A period away from work or study for rest or travel.
An officially recognised day when many people do not work.
To spend time away from home for pleasure.

ex_en: We spent our holiday swimming and exploring quiet villages.
ex_zh: 我们假期里游泳，还探访了宁静的村庄。

senses.en: The place where someone lives or feels they belong.
At or towards the place where you live.
Relating to your house or your own country.

ex_en: We walked home together after dinner at the café.
ex_zh: 在咖啡馆吃过晚饭后，我们一起走回家。

senses.en: The town or city where you grew up or come from.

ex_en: I return to my hometown every summer to visit relatives.
ex_zh: 我每年夏天都回家乡探望亲人。

senses.en: Schoolwork that students are asked to complete outside lessons.
Research or preparation done before making a decision.

ex_en: I finished my homework before dinner and went outside.
ex_zh: 我在晚饭前做完了作业，然后出门了。

senses.en: to want something to happen and believe it may happen
a feeling that something wanted may happen

ex_en: I hope the rain stops before our picnic.
ex_zh: 我希望野餐前雨能停。

senses.en: A large animal used for riding, racing, or pulling loads.

ex_en: The brown horse gently took an apple from my hand.
ex_zh: 那匹棕色的马轻轻地吃走了我手里的苹果。

senses.en: A place where ill or injured people receive medical treatment.

ex_en: She works as a nurse at the local hospital.
ex_zh: 她在当地医院当护士。

senses.en: Having a high temperature.
Having a strong taste that burns your mouth.
Attracting a lot of interest or discussion.

ex_en: Be careful; the soup is still very hot.
ex_zh: 小心，汤还很烫。

senses.en: a building where people pay to stay in rooms

ex_en: Our hotel room overlooks a quiet sandy beach.
ex_zh: 我们住的酒店房间可以俯瞰一片宁静的沙滩。

senses.en: a period of sixty minutes
the times when someone works or a service operates

ex_en: The walk to the lake took us an hour.
ex_zh: 我们走到湖边花了一个小时。

senses.en: A building where a person or family lives.
To provide a place for people or things to stay.

ex_en: Their house has a small garden behind the kitchen.
ex_zh: 他们的房子在厨房后面有一个小花园。

senses.en: Feeling the need or desire to eat.
Having a strong desire for something.

ex_en: I felt hungry after our long walk by the river.
ex_zh: 在河边走了很久之后，我觉得饿了。

senses.en: To move or act quickly, or make someone do so.
A need to act quickly because time is limited.

ex_en: We hurried home before the rain began to fall.
ex_zh: 我们赶在下雨前匆忙回家了。

senses.en: To feel pain or cause physical injury.
To cause emotional pain or damage something.
Physically injured or emotionally upset.
senses.ja_yomi: けがをした、きずついた

ex_en: My ankle still hurts when I climb the stairs.
ex_zh: 我上楼梯时，脚踝还是疼。

senses.en: a married man considered in relation to his spouse
to use resources carefully so they last longer

ex_en: Her husband brought her lunch during a busy shift.
ex_zh: 她忙着上班时，丈夫给她送来了午饭。

senses.en: water that has frozen solid
to cover a cake or biscuit with icing

ex_en: She dropped a few cubes of ice into her juice.
ex_zh: 她往果汁里放了几块冰。

senses.en: A thought or suggestion about what to do.
A mental understanding or belief about something.
Some knowledge or understanding of a situation.

ex_en: Your idea of growing herbs on the balcony sounds lovely.
ex_zh: 你在阳台上种香草的主意听起来很棒。

senses.en: perfect or the best possible for a particular purpose
a belief or standard of perfection someone aims to achieve

ex_en: This quiet corner is ideal for reading after lunch.
ex_zh: 这个安静的角落最适合午饭后看书。

senses.en: introduces a condition for something to happen
introduces an indirect question about whether something is true

ex_en: If it rains, we can play indoors instead.
ex_zh: 如果下雨，我们可以改在室内玩。

senses.en: Form a picture or idea of something in your mind.
Think something is probably true without being certain.

ex_en: Imagine living in a little house beside the sea.
ex_zh: 想象一下住在海边一栋小房子里的情景。

senses.en: Having great value or a significant effect.
senses.ja_yomi: たいせつな、じゅうような

senses.en: Having considerable power, influence, or status.

ex_en: Keep your important documents in this waterproof folder.
ex_zh: 把你的重要文件放在这个防水文件夹里。

senses.en: Inside a place, container, or larger area.
During a period or after a stated amount of time.
Inside a place, moving inside, or at home.

ex_en: Your keys are in the bowl beside the door.
ex_zh: 你的钥匙在门边的碗里。

senses.en: Facts or details about someone or something

ex_en: The receptionist gave us useful information about local buses.
ex_zh: 接待员向我们提供了有关当地公交车的实用信息。

senses.en: in or into the inner part of something
in or into an enclosed place or container
the inner part or surface of something

ex_en: Your keys are inside the small pocket of your bag.
ex_zh: 你的钥匙在包的小口袋里。

senses.en: Wanting to learn about or take part in something.
Likely to be affected by a situation or decision.
senses.ja_yomi: りがいかんけいのある

ex_en: My sister is interested in learning to grow vegetables.
ex_zh: 我姐姐对学习种菜很感兴趣。

senses.en: Making you want to pay attention or learn more.
senses.ja_yomi: おもしろい、きょうみぶかい

ex_en: We found an interesting little museum near the station.
ex_zh: 我们在车站附近发现了一家有趣的小博物馆。

senses.en: The worldwide network connecting computers and other devices.

ex_en: The internet stopped working halfway through our video call.
ex_zh: 我们视频通话进行到一半时断网了。

senses.en: a meeting to assess someone's suitability for a position
a conversation where someone answers questions for media or research
to ask someone questions for selection, reporting, or research
senses.ja: 面接する、インタビューする
senses.ja_yomi: めんせつする、インタビューする

ex_en: I practised answering questions before my first job interview.
ex_zh: 第一次求职面试前，我练习了如何回答问题。

senses.en: towards and then inside something
used to show the result of a change
interested in or enthusiastic about something

ex_en: The kitten jumped into the basket beside my chair.
ex_zh: 小猫跳进了我椅子旁的篮子里。

senses.en: Tell people each other's names when they first meet.
Bring something into use or a place for the first time.
senses.ja_yomi: とりいれる、どうにゅうする

senses.en: Help someone experience or learn about something for the first time.
senses.ja_yomi: はじめてたいけんさせる

ex_en: Let me introduce you to my new neighbour.
ex_zh: 让我把你介绍给我的新邻居。

senses.en: An area of land completely surrounded by water.

ex_en: We took a small boat to the island yesterday.
ex_zh: 昨天我们乘小船去了那座岛。

senses.en: refers to a thing, animal, or situation already mentioned
used as a grammatical subject or object without naming anything
senses.ja_yomi: （けいしきじょうのしゅご・もくてきご）

ex_en: I found your scarf and put it by the door.
ex_zh: 我找到了你的围巾，把它放在门边了。

senses.en: A single object, especially one in a collection.
One part of a list, programme, or news report.

ex_en: Please place each item carefully in the shopping bag.
ex_zh: 请把每件商品小心地放进购物袋。

senses.en: A short coat covering the upper body and arms.
An outer cover that protects a book or object.

ex_en: I grabbed my jacket before stepping into the cold.
ex_zh: 我抓起外套，才走进寒冷的室外。

senses.en: the first month of the year

ex_en: Our swimming lessons begin in January this year.
ex_zh: 我们今年的游泳课从一月开始。

senses.en: Trousers made from strong cotton cloth, usually denim.

ex_en: These jeans are still wet from the wash.
ex_zh: 这条牛仔裤洗后还没干。

senses.en: An aircraft powered by jet engines.
A narrow, forceful stream of liquid or gas.
senses.ja_yomi: ふんしゅつ、ジェットきりゅう

ex_en: A jet flew low over the beach this morning.
ex_zh: 今天早上一架喷气式飞机低空飞过海滩。

senses.en: Decorative objects worn on the body, such as rings and necklaces.
senses.ja_yomi: ほうせきるい、アクセサリー

ex_en: She keeps her jewellery in a small wooden box.
ex_zh: 她把首饰放在一个小木盒里。

senses.en: decorative objects worn on the body, such as rings and necklaces
senses.ja_yomi: ほうせきるい、アクセサリー

ex_en: She keeps her jewelry in a small wooden box.
ex_zh: 她把首饰放在一个小木盒里。

senses.en: paid work that someone does regularly
a particular task or piece of work

ex_en: My sister found a job at the local library.
ex_zh: 我姐姐在当地图书馆找到了一份工作。

senses.en: To become a member or take part with others.
To connect things or become connected.
To go where someone is and spend time with them.

ex_en: Would you like to join us for lunch today?
ex_zh: 你今天愿意和我们一起吃午饭吗？

senses.en: To form an opinion after considering someone or something.
senses.ja_yomi: はんだんする、ひょうかする

senses.en: An official who oversees court proceedings and makes legal decisions.
Someone who assesses performances or decides the winner of a competition.

ex_en: Don't judge the soup until you have tasted it.
ex_zh: 先尝尝这汤，再评价它。

senses.en: liquid obtained from fruit or vegetables

ex_en: She squeezed fresh orange juice into a glass.
ex_zh: 她把鲜橙汁挤进了玻璃杯里。

senses.en: The seventh month of the year, following June

ex_en: We usually visit our cousins for a week in July.
ex_zh: 我们通常在七月去表亲家住一周。

senses.en: To push yourself off the ground into the air.
To increase suddenly by a large amount.
An act of jumping or a sudden large increase.

ex_en: The dog jumped over a puddle beside the gate.
ex_zh: 狗跳过了大门旁的一摊积水。

senses.en: The sixth month of the year, between May and July.

ex_en: My sister is getting married in June this year.
ex_zh: 我姐姐今年六月要结婚了。

senses.en: Only; no more than a particular amount or thing.
Very recently, or exactly at a particular point or degree.
Fair and morally right.

ex_en: I need just one more minute to finish packing.
ex_zh: 我只需要再一分钟就能收拾好行李。

senses.en: To continue having something rather than giving it away.
To stay, or make something stay, in a particular state.
To continue doing something or do it repeatedly.

ex_en: You can keep the umbrella until the rain stops.
ex_zh: 雨停之前，你可以继续留着这把伞用。

senses.en: An object shaped to open or close a particular lock.
Something essential for understanding or achieving something.
Extremely important to a situation or its outcome.

ex_en: I left my house key in my coat pocket.
ex_zh: 我把家门钥匙放在外套口袋里了。

senses.en: to hit something with your foot
an act of hitting something with your foot

ex_en: She kicked the ball gently towards her little brother.
ex_zh: 她轻轻地把球踢向弟弟。

senses.en: A child or young person, in informal language.
Say something playfully that is not meant to be believed.
senses.ja_yomi: からかう、じょうだんをいう

senses.en: A young goat.

ex_en: The kids built a tiny bridge across the stream.
ex_zh: 孩子们在小溪上搭了一座小桥。

senses.en: To cause a person, animal, or other organism to die
To cause something to stop or fail

ex_en: This soap helps kill germs on your hands.
ex_zh: 这种肥皂有助于杀灭手上的病菌。

senses.en: Caring about others and willing to help them.
A group of things sharing similar features.

ex_en: Our kind neighbour brought us soup when we were ill.
ex_zh: 我们生病时，体贴的邻居给我们送来了汤。

senses.en: a male ruler who usually inherits his position

ex_en: The king waved to the crowd from his carriage.
ex_zh: 国王从马车上向人群挥手。

senses.en: to touch someone or something with your lips affectionately
an affectionate touch made with the lips

ex_en: She kissed her daughter gently before leaving for work.
ex_zh: 她上班前轻轻亲了亲女儿。

senses.en: A room where food is prepared and cooked

ex_en: The kitchen smells of fresh bread and roasted vegetables.
ex_zh: 厨房里飘着新鲜面包和烤蔬菜的香味。

senses.en: A lightweight frame flown in the wind on a string
A bird of prey with long wings and often a forked tail

ex_en: We flew a bright kite on the windy beach.
ex_zh: 我们在风大的海滩上放了一只色彩鲜艳的风筝。

senses.en: The joint where your leg bends in the middle.

ex_en: She bent her knee gently before starting the exercise.
ex_zh: 开始锻炼前，她轻轻弯了弯膝盖。

senses.en: a tool with a handle and blade used for cutting

ex_en: Use a sharp knife to slice the bread.
ex_zh: 用一把锋利的刀把面包切成片。

senses.en: To have information or understanding about something
To be familiar with a person, place, or thing

ex_en: Do you know how to fix this bicycle?
ex_zh: 你知道怎么修这辆自行车吗？

senses.en: a polite word for an adult woman

ex_en: A kind lady helped me find the station.
ex_zh: 一位好心的女士帮我找到了车站。

senses.en: a system of words or gestures used for communication
the words and style used in a particular context

ex_en: My neighbour teaches me a little of her language.
ex_zh: 邻居教我一点她的语言。

senses.en: greater than usual in size, amount, or number

ex_en: A large dog was sleeping beside the kitchen door.
ex_zh: 一只大狗正睡在厨房门旁。

senses.en: after the expected time or near the end of a period
senses.ja: おくれた、終わりごろの
senses.ja_yomi: おくれた、おわりごろの

senses.en: after the expected time or towards a period's end
used before mentioning a person who has died

ex_en: I was late because my bicycle had a flat tyre.
ex_zh: 我迟到了，因为我的自行车轮胎没气了。

senses.en: at a time after now or another mentioned time
happening or existing after another time or stage

ex_en: I'll wash the dishes later, after we finish eating.
ex_zh: 等我们吃完饭，我稍后再洗碗。

senses.en: To make sounds showing amusement or happiness.
The sound or act of expressing amusement.

ex_en: The baby's funny dance made everyone laugh at dinner.
ex_zh: 宝宝滑稽的舞蹈让吃晚饭的每个人都笑了。

senses.en: unwilling to work or make an effort
relaxed and involving little activity

ex_en: I felt too lazy to cook dinner tonight.
ex_zh: 今晚我懒得做饭。

senses.en: Someone who guides or directs a group of people.
A person or organization ahead of others in a field.

ex_en: Our group leader showed us the safest mountain path.
ex_zh: 我们的领队给我们指明了最安全的山路。

senses.en: To gain knowledge or a skill through study or experience.
To find out information about something.

ex_en: My grandfather is learning to swim at the local pool.
ex_zh: 我爷爷正在附近的游泳池学游泳。

senses.en: To go away from a person or place.
To let something remain somewhere, deliberately or accidentally.
senses.ja: 置いていく、置き忘れる
senses.ja_yomi: おいていく、おきわすれる

senses.en: An officially allowed period away from work.

ex_en: We need to leave before the traffic gets worse.
ex_zh: 我们得在交通变得更拥堵之前出发。

senses.en: On the side opposite the right.
Towards or on the side opposite the right.
Still available or remaining after others have gone or been used.

ex_en: I carry my shopping bag in my left hand.
ex_zh: 我用左手提购物袋。

senses.en: a body part used for standing and walking
a support beneath a table, chair, or similar object
one stage of a journey or race

ex_en: My legs felt tired after the long walk home.
ex_zh: 走了很长一段路回家后，我的双腿很累。

senses.en: A period of teaching or learning a particular subject.
Something useful learned from an experience, especially a mistake.

ex_en: Our swimming lesson starts after school on Thursday.
ex_zh: 我们的游泳课在周四放学后开始。

senses.en: To allow someone to do something or something to happen.
To allow someone to use property in exchange for rent.

ex_en: Please let me know when you arrive home safely.
ex_zh: 你平安到家后请告诉我。

senses.en: a written message sent to a person or organisation
a written symbol representing a sound in an alphabet

ex_en: A letter from my sister arrived this morning.
ex_zh: 今天早上，我收到了姐姐寄来的信。

senses.en: A place where people read or borrow books and other materials.
An organised collection of books, recordings, or digital resources.
senses.ja: 資料の集まり、ライブラリー
senses.ja_yomi: しりょうのあつまり、ライブラリー

ex_en: I borrowed three books from the library after school.
ex_zh: 放学后，我从图书馆借了三本书。

senses.en: the experiences and activities of being alive
the state of being alive
the period during which someone lives or something works
senses.ja_yomi: じゅみょう、つかえるきかん

ex_en: Life feels quieter since we moved to the countryside.
ex_zh: 自从搬到乡下，我们的生活感觉更安静了。

senses.en: brightness that enables sight, or a device producing it
not heavy, bright, or pale in colour
senses.ja: 軽い、明るい、うすい色の
senses.ja_yomi: かるい、あかるい、うすいいろの

senses.en: make something burn or provide brightness

ex_en: Warm light came through the curtains into our bedroom.
ex_zh: 温暖的光线透过窗帘照进了我们的卧室。

senses.en: to enjoy something or feel positively about someone
similar to someone or something
used to introduce an example

ex_en: I like reading by the window on rainy afternoons.
ex_zh: 我喜欢在下雨的午后坐在窗边读书。

senses.en: A plant with large, often trumpet-shaped flowers.

ex_en: A white lily opened beside our kitchen window this morning.
ex_zh: 今天早晨，我们厨房窗边的一朵白百合开了。

senses.en: a long, thin mark on a surface
people or things arranged one behind or beside another
a route or connection for transport or communication

ex_en: Draw a straight line across the page with your ruler.
ex_zh: 用尺子在纸上画一条直线。

senses.en: A large wild cat, whose males usually have thick neck hair.

ex_en: The lion rested beneath a tree in the shade.
ex_zh: 那头狮子在树荫下休息。

senses.en: Related items or names written one below another.
senses.ja_yomi: リスト、いちらんひょう

senses.en: To write or state items one after another.

ex_en: I made a shopping list before leaving home.
ex_zh: 出门前，我列了一张购物清单。

senses.en: to pay attention to sounds or what someone is saying
senses.ja_yomi: きく、みみをかたむける

senses.en: to take someone's advice or warnings seriously

ex_en: I listen to music while cooking dinner every evening.
ex_zh: 每天晚上做饭时，我都会听音乐。

senses.en: Small in size or young in age.
Not much; almost no amount of something.
Only slightly or not very much.

ex_en: A little bird landed on our kitchen windowsill.
ex_zh: 一只小鸟落在我们厨房的窗台上。

senses.en: to have your home somewhere, lead a life, or remain alive
broadcast or performed as it happens, rather than recorded
alive rather than dead

ex_en: My grandparents live in a quiet village near the coast.
ex_zh: 我的祖父母住在海边一个安静的村庄里。

senses.en: Alive now, rather than dead or without life.
Money earned to pay for everyday needs.
The way people live and meet their everyday needs.

ex_en: The pond is full of tiny living creatures.
ex_zh: 池塘里满是微小的生物。

senses.en: Unhappy because you lack companionship or close connections.
Far from people or rarely visited.

ex_en: I felt lonely until my neighbour invited me for tea.
ex_zh: 我一直觉得孤单，直到邻居邀请我去喝茶。

senses.en: Extending a great distance or lasting a great time.
For a great amount of time.
To want something very strongly, especially something unavailable.

ex_en: Her long scarf nearly touched the wet pavement.
ex_zh: 她的长围巾差点碰到湿漉漉的人行道。

senses.en: direct your eyes towards someone or something
appear to have a particular quality or condition
an act of looking, or someone's expression or appearance
senses.ja_yomi: みること、ひょうじょう、がいけん

ex_en: Look at the tiny bird beside the window.
ex_zh: 看窗边那只小鸟。

senses.en: a large amount or number, in a lot or lots
very much or often, in the phrase a lot
an area of land used for a particular purpose

ex_en: We bought a lot of fresh fruit today.
ex_zh: 我们今天买了很多新鲜水果。

senses.en: feel deep affection for someone or enjoy something very much
a strong feeling of affection or great enjoyment

ex_en: I love walking by the river after dinner.
ex_zh: 我很喜欢晚饭后沿着河边散步。

senses.en: beautiful or attractive in a pleasing way
senses.ja_yomi: うつくしい、かわいらしい

senses.en: very pleasant, enjoyable, or kind
senses.ja_yomi: すてきな、かんじのよい

ex_en: There are lovely yellow flowers beside the kitchen window.
ex_zh: 厨房窗边有一些漂亮的黄色花朵。

senses.en: Having good things happen by chance.
Believed to bring good fortune.

ex_en: We were lucky to catch the last bus home.
ex_zh: 我们很幸运，赶上了回家的末班公交车。

senses.en: a meal eaten around the middle of the day
to eat a meal around midday
senses.ja_yomi: ちゅうしょくをたべる

ex_en: We ate lunch under a tree beside the river.
ex_zh: 我们在河边的一棵树下吃了午饭。

senses.en: A device with moving parts that performs a particular job.
To shape or finish material using a machine.

ex_en: The washing machine shook loudly during its final spin.
ex_zh: 洗衣机在最后脱水时剧烈晃动，声音很大。

senses.en: A regularly published collection of articles and pictures.

ex_en: She bought a gardening magazine at the station.
ex_zh: 她在车站买了一本园艺杂志。

senses.en: letters and parcels sent or delivered through a postal service
senses.ja_yomi: ゆうびん、ゆうびんぶつ

senses.en: to send a letter or parcel through a postal service

ex_en: The mail arrived just as we finished breakfast.
ex_zh: 我们刚吃完早饭，邮件就到了。

senses.en: to create or produce something
to cause a state or force an action
the brand or type of a manufactured product

ex_en: We made a small table from leftover pieces of wood.
